Ghi BR khop wiki onboarding checklist RULE (dung chu two, khong so 2):
BR-01: HR must create an onboarding case before day one.
BR-02: IT account provisioning starts only after HR checklist is ready.
BR-03: Manager confirms buddy assignment within two business days.
BR-04: Access must use least privilege roles from the org catalog.
BR-05: Do not grant admin rights by default.
